screening_variants: combination if component evidence supports it
selection: Report every variant. Prefer paired recall gains with no >0.005 recall decline in any dev corpus/capacity. Assess precision/IoU, per-language losses and embedding token overhead; do not claim precision advantage solely from leaving more budget unused. Choose using development only; no per-query/language/dataset identifiers in source.
validation: Freeze one source and two pretrained model revisions before opening new validation. Evaluate baseline,current,chosen candidate and all declared rivals once per encoder, all capacities/budgets predeclared. Report full frontier and all losses; no repeated validation tuning.
claims: Scope any advantage to measured workloads/models/budgets, disclose selection and bootstrap/article correlation, do not promise universal superiority.
